lead.headline: 18 small public companies filed annual reports past the legal extension three years running; 4 still list on major exchanges
lead.number: 18 past the 15-day extension FY2023-FY2025; 4 still list a Nasdaq/NYSE ticker: Laser Photonics, Global Interactive Technologies, BIO-key, EON Resources
lead.watch_out: FY2025 lateness comes from audit-report dates, not actual 10-K filing dates; about half of the 439 FY2025 misses dated their audits inside the extension.
